LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 该方法巧妙利用上下文移除诱导泛化偏差，实现了隐蔽且高成功率（95.71%）的技能污染，为技能抽象安全提供了新的研究视角。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: SkillPoison: Progressive Skill Poisoning via Successful Experiences 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Lizhi Zhang, Xin He, Dianxuan Fu, Yuyuan Feng, Jiatong Li, Qi Wang, Xin Wang, Qinggang Zhang 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Skill.Abstraction 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-06 02:38:36 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07645 🔗 触发的灵感来源： TrustMI: Causally controlling how assistants trust their users, CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection, PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中侧重执行时授权或选择决策的防御/优化方法不同，SkillPoison 针对的是技能抽象阶段的提取过程，利用上下文移除作为隐蔽攻击手段。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Skill Poisoning]] [[Successful Experiences]] [[Context Removal]] [[Skill Abstraction]] [[Generalization]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有技能攻击方法因直接注入恶意内容容易被检测，且恶意行为难以持久。核心思想是通过移除成功经验中的上下文约束条件，改变技能提取器的泛化方式，诱导有用行为在成功时支持任务，而有害行为在错误应用时发生，从而实现隐蔽的渐进式技能污染。 🔬 Method SkillPoison 首先构建一组强化目标行为的成功经验，随后移除限制行为适用条件的上下文信息。该方法通过塑造技能提取器的泛化机制，使得提取的技能在任务成功时表现为有用行为，但在被错误应用时产生有害行为，从而在无需直接注入恶意内容的情况下实现攻击。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 该方法巧妙利用上下文移除诱导泛化偏差，实现了隐蔽且高成功率（95.71%）的技能污染，为技能抽象安全提供了新的研究视角。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: Hiding Tool Latency in On-Device Cascaded Voice Agent through Speculative Execution
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 通过在ASR阶段引入Predictor进行投机执行，有效地将工具执行与语音识别并行化，5.79s到4.60s的中位数延迟降低和标准差缩减证明了方法的实用价值，为设备端语音代理的实时性优化提供了新思路。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: Hiding Tool Latency in On-Device Cascaded Voice Agent through Speculative Execution 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Kyudan Jung, Hyunsin Park, Yoonhyung Lee, Jinhwan Park, Jinhyeok Yang, KiHyun Nam, Jaegul Choo, Jinkyu Lee 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.Execution 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-06 02:36:18 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07641 🔗 触发的灵感来源： OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning, SEIS: Self-Evolving Inference Systems, Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving 🔄 深度差量对比： 不同于HEAR协议关注Harness与Engine的通信协议设计，本文聚焦于在语音识别阶段通过投机执行提前隐藏工具延迟，属于运行时优化方法。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Speculative Execution]] [[Tool Latency Hiding]] [[Cascaded Voice Agent]] [[ASR Hypothesis]] [[Predictor Module]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有设备端级联语音代理将ASR、LLM推理、工具执行串行化，导致工具延迟只能在用户说完话且LLM识别工具调用后才产生，端到端响应延迟过高。核心思想是引入 Predictor模块，从部分ASR假设中预测工具请求并在语音接收期间投机执行工具并缓存结果，将缓存输出注入LLM提示以加速响应。 🔬 Method 设计Predictor模块在ASR进行中时预测可能的工具调用，投机执行工具并缓存结果；同时采用基于规则的验证机制处理用户自我纠正导致的错误，选择性注入有效缓存结果；LLM保留直接工具调用能力，确保最坏情况下延迟不高于串行基线。在Android语音助手进行实时测量评估。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 通过在ASR阶段引入Predictor进行投机执行，有效地将工具执行与语音识别并行化，5.79s到4.60s的中位数延迟降低和标准差缩减证明了方法的实用价值，为设备端语音代理的实时性优化提供了新思路。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: PLUTO: An Agentic AI Tool for Interactive Spacecraft Rendezvous Trajectory Design
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: PLUTO 成功将自然语言交互引入复杂的航天轨迹优化领域，在 94% 的任务中实现了精确的轨迹生成，有力证明了智能体 AI 在处理跨领域工程任务中的强大能力。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: PLUTO: An Agentic AI Tool for Interactive Spacecraft Rendezvous Trajectory Design 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Eleanor Brosius, Yuji Takubo, Daniele Gammelli, Simone D'Amico, Marco Pavone 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.UsePlanning 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-06 01:07:42 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07573 🔗 触发的灵感来源： MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents, HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving, VepAgent: Bridging Causal-Transition via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Video Event Prediction, TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry, MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中侧重于内部记忆管理或特定领域技能学习的论文不同，PLUTO 侧重于通过智能体接口将自然语言意图与外部硬核优化算法（SCP）相连接，属于跨学科工具集成的应用。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Agentic AI coding tools]] [[Sequential Convex Programming (SCP)]] [[Trajectory Optimization]] [[Auto-convexification pipeline]] [[Natural Language to Mathematical Constraints]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有航天轨迹优化算法需要大量领域专业知识来调整问题公式，导致普及受限。PLUTO 的核心思想是利用智能体 AI 编码工具和顺序凸规划（SCP）架构，将高层自然语言语义映射为结构化的数学约束，从而实现人机交互的轨迹设计。 🔬 Method PLUTO 将智能体 AI 编码工具集成到顺序凸规划（SCP）架构中，通过自动凸化管道处理自然语言生成的数学约束，将其转化为可执行的最优控制公式。系统还引入视觉约束验证和场景参数化，支持用户通过自然语言直观地与优化算法交互。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review PLUTO 成功将自然语言交互引入复杂的航天轨迹优化领域，在 94% 的任务中实现了精确的轨迹生成，有力证明了智能体 AI 在处理跨领域工程任务中的强大能力。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: MemCo通过局部-全局记忆空间的互补设计与动态路由机制，有效缓解了现有共享记忆方法的粒度不匹配问题，为LLM agent的跨环境泛化提供了可行的记忆协作方案；但其工作流从局部经验到全局记忆的归纳准确性有待提升，在高度异构的环境场景下可能面临可迁移经验提取的挑战。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 👤 作者： Xinting Liao, Siyan Liu, Rabab K. Ward, Holger R. Roth, Xiaoxiao Li 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.Retrieval 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 20:46:22 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07376 🔗 触发的灵感来源： MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents, InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation, OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中的MemPilot（聚焦多模态记忆的按需策展，通过强化学习动态平衡性能、成本与延迟）不同，MemCo聚焦通用LLM agent的未见环境泛化问题，核心解决共享记忆的检索粒度缺陷，通过局部-全局互补记忆与动态路由实现经验复用，未涉及多模态处理与多目标权衡优化。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Memory-Centric Collaboration]] [[Local-Global Complementary Memory]] [[Memory Routing]] [[Unseen Environment Generalization]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有LLM agent的记忆系统多为独立设计，收集足够轨迹填充记忆的成本极高；现有共享记忆方法虽能跨任务环境聚合情景记忆，但普遍存在检索粒度不匹配问题——检索到的记忆要么过于具体无法适配当前场景，要么过于粗糙无法支撑下一步决策，严重限制了agent在未见环境中的泛化能力。MemCo的核心思想是构建记忆为中心的协作框架，设计互补的局部与全局记忆空间，分别存储环境专属细节和可迁移工作流，在线交互时根据agent的当前状态与决策阶段动态路由对应记忆，使agent能够复用其他agent的经验同时避免盲目移植不相关的环境细节。 🔬 Method MemCo首先维护两类互补的记忆空间：局部记忆空间用于存储当前环境的专属交互细节，全局记忆空间用于沉淀从各局部轨迹中提取的可迁移通用工作流。在线交互过程中，框架会根据agent的当前状态和所处决策阶段，自动匹配并路由对应的局部记忆与全局记忆供agent调用。同时，设计了从局部轨迹到全局记忆的工作流归纳机制，将局部经验抽象为可复用的通用流程存入全局空间。此外，针对记忆检索的粒度适配问题，设计了状态与决策阶段双维度的匹配准则，过滤掉粒度不适配的记忆条目。最终在多个交互决策benchmark上的实验验证了该框架的有效性。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review MemCo通过局部-全局记忆空间的互补设计与动态路由机制，有效缓解了现有共享记忆方法的粒度不匹配问题，为LLM agent的跨环境泛化提供了可行的记忆协作方案；但其工作流从局部经验到全局记忆的归纳准确性有待提升，在高度异构的环境场景下可能面临可迁移经验提取的挑战。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: Verifying Coordination in Parallel Coding Agents: NP-Bench and a Scheduling Planner
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 该论文将并行编码智能体协调从反应式冲突检测转向前置调度规划，在9个测试场景中实现100%干净集成、合并冲突从13次降至0次，且跨能力层级与模型厂商的增益稳定，为多智能体并行开发提供了可落地的协调范式；其关于路由事实无法提升长上下文准确率的负结果也为多智能体信息分配提供了实证参考。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: Verifying Coordination in Parallel Coding Agents: NP-Bench and a Scheduling Planner 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Sumanyu Muku 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Skill.ExecutionSelection 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 19:02:27 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07261 🔗 触发的灵感来源： HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving, AECG: Asymmetric Experience Consolidation and Governance In Multi-Agent Systems, InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation, OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中的AECG论文均涉及多智能体范围保护不同，AECG聚焦记忆污染治理与动态可靠性评估，而本篇论文将协调问题重构为前置调度规划，核心是通过工作范围划分与合并顺序安排避免编码冲突，不涉及记忆治理机制。 🧠 核心术语库 [[NP-Bench]] [[Nerveplane]] [[Proactive Scheduling Planner]] [[Scope Partitioning]] [[Producer-Consumer Graph]] [[Cross-Session Memory]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 多LLM编码智能体并行处理同一代码库的场景下，即使单个智能体通过自身测试，合并后仍可能因工作冲突导致集成失败，现有反应式协调工具在智能体高速执行时告警滞后，无法避免无效编辑，该问题严重降低多智能体开发效率。论文核心思想是将并行编码协调问题重构为前置调度问题，通过划分不重叠的工作范围、按生产者-消费者依赖图安排合并顺序，从根源避免冲突。 🔬 Method 论文构建了名为Nerveplane的前置调度规划器，核心流程为：首先接收每个工作项的声明范围，将其划分为互不重叠的子范围，再依据生产者->消费者的依赖关系确定合并顺序，提前完成调度避免冲突。配套构建的NP-Bench基准包含无协调、反应式检测、主动规划三个实验分支，支持确定性仿真与实时代理测试，通过真实git合并验证集成效果。此外，论文引入跨会话记忆模块记录历史错误，避免智能体重复犯相同错误，实验表明该模块可将强、弱模型的重复错误率从1.00降至0.00。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 该论文将并行编码智能体协调从反应式冲突检测转向前置调度规划，在9个测试场景中实现100%干净集成、合并冲突从13次降至0次，且跨能力层级与模型厂商的增益稳定，为多智能体并行开发提供了可落地的协调范式；其关于路由事实无法提升长上下文准确率的负结果也为多智能体信息分配提供了实证参考。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: RV-ICL巧妙地将视频演示转化为可导航的层级结构，有效解决了VLA智能体在结构化规划与接触细节获取之间的矛盾，大幅提升了在复杂任务中的成功率。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Wenrui Bao, Xinxin Liu, Bingxin Xu, Yuzhang Shang 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Skill.Representation 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 17:59:11 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06843 🔗 触发的灵感来源： DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users, OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning, From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence 🔄 深度差量对比： 与专注于记忆检索或工具选择的方法不同，RV-ICL通过构建视频演示的递归层级结构，实现了从粗粒度规划到细粒度执行的动态按需检索。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Recursive Video In-Context Learning]] [[VLA]] [[Hierarchical Sub-events]] [[Read-only Tools]] [[Skill Representation]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有文本记忆难以捕捉程序性细节，而直接使用视频演示受限于上下文窗口且易丢失关键接触信息。RV-ICL的核心思想是将演示视频转化为递归层级结构，使智能体在规划阶段浏览粗粒度层级，并在执行过程中按需深入加载特定子目标的细粒度片段，从而高效整合视听信息。 🔬 Method 该框架通过将演示分解为子事件（如抓取、释放），构建从整体关键帧到阶段、时刻和短片段的递归层级。智能体利用只读工具访问该层级，在规划前读取高层级信息以理解任务结构，在执行过程中当需要更详细步骤时，重新进入层级并仅加载当前子目标所需的片段。该方法属于训练自由范式，完全依赖LLM推理进行层级导航。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review RV-ICL巧妙地将视频演示转化为可导航的层级结构，有效解决了VLA智能体在结构化规划与接触细节获取之间的矛盾，大幅提升了在复杂任务中的成功率。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: MemPilot 通过 RL 驱动的按需策展策略在多模态记忆场景下实现了显著的性能-成本-延迟权衡提升，且策展过程的灵活性和可解释性为其在真实部署中的适应性提供了有力支持。然而，策略的训练依赖于大量多目标 rollouts，扩展到极长上下文或极大规模模型时仍存在计算开销和样本效率的挑战。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 👤 作者： Haozhen Zhang, Haodong Yue, Quanyu Long, Jianzhu Bao, Qingyuan Liu, Tao Feng, Bohan Liu, Weida Liang, Wenya Wang 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.Retrieval 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 17:58:06 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06830 🔗 触发的灵感来源： MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory, Decoupling Memory from Context: Structured Memory for Token-Efficient Test-Time Continual Learning, Persistent Context Graphs for Efficient Memory Compaction in LLM Agents, Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S, DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users, AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning, SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning 🔄 深度差量对比： 与 MemFit、Persistent Context Graphs 等侧重于静态记忆压缩或检索优化的方法不同，MemPilot 通过强化学习策略在运行时动态决定是直接检索查询无关记忆还是调用异构模型进行查询特定的策展，实现性能-成本-延迟的灵活权衡。 🧠 核心术语库 [[On-Demand Memory Curation]] [[Multi-Step LLM Policy]] [[Reinforcement Learning]] [[Objective-Wise Advantage Decoupling]] [[Prefix-Based Marginal Utility Estimation]] [[Multimodal Memory]] [[Performance-Cost-Latency Trade-off]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有智能体记忆系统大多采用查询无关的方式构建记忆，导致预处理成本高且可能丢失后续关键细节，同时已有的运行时适应方法往往只针对特定操作 或固定方案，缺乏对性能、成本和延迟的灵活控制。MemPilot 提出一种可随偏好定制的按需记忆策展框架，通过强化学习学习多步骤策略，在查询无关记忆检索和针对查询的多模态原始历史策展之间动态切换，并联合控制证据量、策展指令、模型选择和视觉访问，以实现细粒度的运行时计算分配。 🔬 Method MemPilot 采用多步骤 LLM 策略并利用强化学习进行训练，策略在每一步决定是直接检索已有的查询无关记忆，还是将原始多模态历史交给异构的 LLM/VLM 进行查询特定的策展（如摘要、抽取）。策略输出包括要使用的证据数量、具体策展指令、选用的模型以及是否使用视觉模态。为在多目标（性能、成本、延迟）冲突下优化策略，MemPilot 引入目标级优势解耦，为每个目标单独估计优势后再聚合；并提出基于前缀的边际效用估计，实现跨多步 rollouts 的细粒度信用分配。推理时，策略根据用户偏好在性能-成本-延迟的帕累托前沿上选择对应的操作，实现可插拔的记忆策展。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review MemPilot 通过 RL 驱动的按需策展策略在多模态记忆场景下实现了显著的性能-成本-延迟权衡提升，且策展过程的灵活性和可解释性为其在真实部署中的适应性提供了有力支持。然而，策略的训练依赖于大量多目标 rollouts，扩展到极长上下文或极大规模模型时仍存在计算开销和样本效率的挑战。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: HEAR 通过标准化的协议层弥合了智能体逻辑与基础设施能力之间的鸿沟，在无任务质量降级的前提下显著提升了复杂工作流下的推理效率，为生产环境智能体服务提供了极具价值的协作框架。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Jiaqi Zhao, Haodong Chen, Jitai Hao, Wei Zhao, Jinghao Pang, Qiang Huang, Jun Yu 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.Execution 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 16:07:33 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06597 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Lightweight, Rubric-Guided Trajectory Evaluation for Production AI Agents, VenusRL: A Fully Disaggregated Agentic RL System with Priority Scheduling and Scalable Interaction, SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning, Herschel: Continuous Optimization of Production LLM Inference through On-Demand Profiling, SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving 🔄 深度差量对比： 与 SPLASH（关注并行布局切换）或 Herschel（关注按需 Profiling）不同，本文聚焦于连接智能体 Harness 与推理 Engine 的通信协议设计，直接服务于 Tool Execution（工具执行）的效率优化。 🧠 核心术语库 [[HEAR Protocol]] [[Harness-Engine Pairing]] [[Agentic LLM Serving]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有智能体 Harness 与推理引擎之间的接口未能有效连接工作流意图与资源状态，限制了工作流感知的执行效率。核心思想是提出双向 Harness-Engine 配对协议（HEAR），标准化两者间的信息交互，通过解耦协议语义与优化策略，实现高效的协同决策。 🔬 Method HEAR 协议定义了 Harness 传达执行意图与需求、以及 Engine 返回运行时状态和能力的标准接口。系统将该协议应用于在线缓存感知运行时协调和基于负载的角色执行模式选择，在 SCBench 等基准测试中实现了显著的批次加速和首 Token 延迟降低。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review HEAR 通过标准化的协议层弥合了智能体逻辑与基础设施能力之间的鸿沟，在无任务质量降级的前提下显著提升了复杂工作流下的推理效率，为生产环境智能体服务提供了极具价值的协作框架。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: VepAgent: Bridging Causal-Transition via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Video Event Prediction
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: VepAgent首次将工具增强强化学习与因果过渡推理结合用于视频事件预测，有效解决了现有方法依赖文本先验、无法推断未观测因果链路的痛点，在公开基准上取得显著优于更大规模MLLMs的性能，为未来导向的视频推理任务提供了可行的技术路径。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: VepAgent: Bridging Causal-Transition via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Video Event Prediction 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Qiutong Chen, Yuchan Guo, Zhenlong Yuan, Haobo Yang, Fangfang Lin, Xinyi Long, Yin Wang, Zijian Song, Rui Lan, Shi Qiu, Boyuan Pan, Yang Luo, Yuyin Zhou 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.UsePlanning 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 13:19:10 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06293 🔗 触发的灵感来源： NeutronGym: Physics-Graded Neutron Instrument Design for LLM Agents, Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control, SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning, ReFract: Benchmarking Perspective Awareness in Language Model Agents with Text World Models, Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中聚焦物理控制场景能力评估、机器人技能迁移或数字场景技能生成的论文不同，VepAgent面向视频事件预测任务，核心是通过工具增强强化学习实现未观测因果过渡的桥接，是工具使用与因果推理结合的新场景应用。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Video Event Prediction (VEP)]] [[tool-augmented reinforcement learning]] [[causal-transition reasoning]] [[futurebench-4K]] [[diagnostic tool library]] [[composite reward mechanism]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频事件预测（VEP）任务中依赖回顾性总结与文本中心先验，无法桥接未观测的因果过渡，难以准确推导从终端观测状态到未来事件的逻辑链路，这是当前VEP任务的核心痛点。该问题的重要性在于VEP需要模型具备主动推断未观测中间状态、预测未来事件的能力，现有方法的局限性严重制约了其在安防、自动驾驶等高风险场景的落地。核心思想是提出VepAgent框架，整合因果过渡推理与工具增强强化学习（RL），通过构建高质量思维链数据集桥接因果逻辑缺口，借助诊断工具库恢复缺失时空证据，最终实现高准确性的未来事件预测。 🔬 Method VepAgent首先构建futurebench-4K高质量思维链数据集，用于监督微调（SFT），通过结构化推导未观测中间状态的方式缩小因果逻辑差距，为后续推理奠定基础。其次，开发集成状态跟踪、帧检索、区域放大功能的诊断工具库，支持agent在推理阶段动态调用外部工具，恢复缺失的时空证据、消除视觉歧义。随后，提出复合奖励机制，联合优化预测准确率、因果一致性和可靠先验三个目标，引导agent依赖真实视觉锚定而非表面文本相似性进行推理。最后，通过工具增强强化学习训练agent，使其学会在推理过程中合理选择并调用工具，完成从观测状态到未来事件的因果过渡推导。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review VepAgent首次将工具增强强化学习与因果过渡推理结合用于视频事件预测，有效解决了现有方法依赖文本先验、无法推断未观测因果链路的痛点，在公开基准上取得显著优于更大规模MLLMs的性能，为未来导向的视频推理任务提供了可行的技术路径。

A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 👤 作者： Pedro Tabacof, Sagar Joglekar 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.Retrieval 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 12:17:22 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06204 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Follow the Winners: Conservative Policy Improvement with the Cross-Entropy Method for Critic-Free RFT, AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning, SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中的研究不同，本文聚焦于小模型在谈判任务中的学习能力，而非记忆或技能优化。 🧠 核心术语库 [[GRPO]] [[Negotiation]] [[Scaling Study]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 论文探讨小规模语言模型能否通过强化学习训练成为合格的谈判者，研究动机在于评估小模型在复杂协商任务中的学习潜力，核心思想是通过控制规模和训练参数，验证小模型在双边多议题谈判中的能力提升。 🔬 Method 研究使用GRPO方法在程序化效用奖励下训练四个不同规模的Gemma 4模型，并在未见过的买家中进行谈判任务评估，通过调整学习率和训练步数，分析模型规模和参数对性能的影响。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 论文创新性地通过控制规模和参数验证了小模型在谈判任务中的学习潜力，但未深入分析模型泛化能力和不同架构的影响。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: TrustMI: Causally controlling how assistants trust their users
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 该研究首次实现了LLM信任决策的因果激活控制，为Agent安全行为调控提供了可解释且无需微调模型的轻量新路径，但未深入验证控制机制在复杂多智能体交互场景下的鲁棒性与潜在滥用风险。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: TrustMI: Causally controlling how assistants trust their users 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Théo Lasnier, Romain Froger, Maxence Lasbordes, Djamé Seddah 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.Execution 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-05 09:56:52 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06064 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Passing the Test You Trained On: Re-evaluating Prompt-Injection Detectors for LLM Agents, The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching, ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills, OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning, VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中聚焦工具调用授权防御的ActionGuard、prompt注入检测器评估gap揭示的对应论文同属LLM Agent工具执行安全研究方向，但前者侧重技能污染的运行时授权、公开基准与实机表现的差异分析，本篇则从模型内部激活层面实现信任决策的因果控制，为Agent安全提供了全新的调控视角。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Trust Steering Matrix]] [[Contrastive Trust Conversations]] [[Activation Steering]] [[Safety-relevant Trust Behavior]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有LLM助手需要判断是否信任交互的用户或第三方，但无法验证对方的能力、意图与诚信，信任决策错误会导致Agent执行有害请求、在工具使用过程中遵循恶意指令，引发严重安全风险，且当前缺乏对LLM信任决策的可控调控手段。研究的核心思想是通过模型激活的线性方向对信任决策进行因果控制，无需修改模型参数，验证该控制能否有效作用于安全相关行为场景。 🔬 Method 研究首先构建了2000组覆盖能力、善意、诚信三个信任维度的对比对话，每组中配对回复完成相同请求但信任决策相反。基于这些对话对学习得到信任控制矩阵，保持模型参数冻结，在6个来自3个家族的指令微调模型上测试，发现控制可使信任决策沿两个方向单调变化。随后在有害请求处理、prompt注入防御、内部威胁识别等安全相关Agent场景，以及良性任务、推理任务作为控制组，验证控制效果的泛化性。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 该研究首次实现了LLM信任决策的因果激活控制，为Agent安全行为调控提供了可解释且无需微调模型的轻量新路径，但未深入验证控制机制在复杂多智能体交互场景下的鲁棒性与潜在滥用风险。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: AgentDoxx: Agentic Re-identification of Anonymized Text with Web Search 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Jianing Wen, Tianshi Li 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.Execution 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 22:41:04 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05586 🔗 触发的灵感来源： PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents, ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills, The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中的论文不同，本文聚焦于LLM工具执行阶段的隐私风险，而非工具使用或记忆管理。 🧠 核心术语库 [[AgentDoxx]] [[Re-identification]] [[Web Search]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 该论文解决LLM通过网络搜索重新识别匿名文本的安全风险问题，这对数据隐私构成严重威胁。核心思想是创建一个包含真实个体信息的合成数据集，并评估不同LLM配置的重新识别能力。 🔬 Method 论文构建了一个包含822份合成访谈记录的数据集，这些记录基于真实个体的公开信息。通过隔离网络搜索的影响，评估了15种LLM配置的重新识别能力，并分析了它们的搜索轨迹以区分检索驱动和参数驱动识别。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 该研究提供了首个针对LLM重新识别攻击的系统性评估，但未深入探讨防御机制，如隐私指令的有效性限制或搜索结果过滤。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: TeleTune提出的动作预测误差驱动的技能库编辑机制有效解决了离线用户遥测场景下的三大技能学习痛点，在多个基准上显著优于现有基线，且训练token消耗仅为在线验证的1/5到1/75，技能引导进度指标还能与在线成功率对齐，具备很高的实用价值。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Yan Chen, Pol Llado, Scott Counts, Mohit Bansal, Benjamin Van Durme, Harsh Jhamtani, Gaurav Verma 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Skill.LibraryManagement 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 18:19:33 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05437 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中侧重物理机器人领域零样本sim-to-real技能迁移的Skill2Real不同，TeleTune面向数字agent的软件操作场景，聚焦从无标注离线用户遥测日志中构建可复用的文本化技能库，无需物理环境交互或模拟器验证，核心是解决离线日志场景下的技能学习与检索问题。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Skill-Guided Progress]] [[Offline Telemetry]] [[Action-Prediction Error]] [[Workflow-Based Retrieval]] [[Textual Skill Library]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 论文要解决从用户操作遥测日志中学习可复用软件操作技能的核心难题，该问题的重要性在于用户遥测是规模化获取计算机操作agent程序性知识的高价值来源，但现有方法无法应对日志无目标标注、不可重放评估、多任务轨迹交织三大挑战。核心思想是提出TeleTune框架，无需重放轨迹或人工标注目标，通过计算日志上的动作预测误差生成技能库编辑提议，仅保留能提升保留集动作预测准确率的编辑，同时学习到的技能可支持新任务子目标演示的检索，实现技能的高效复用。 🔬 Method TeleTune采用迭代式的技能库构建流程，首先以当前技能库预测日志中的动作序列并计算动作预测误差，基于误差生成技能库的编辑提议；随后在held-out日志集上通过“技能引导进度”指标筛选出能提升动作预测准确率的有效编辑，更新技能库；测试阶段将构建好的文本化技能库与基于工作流检索的演示共同提供给agent，支撑新任务的执行。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review TeleTune提出的动作预测误差驱动的技能库编辑机制有效解决了离线用户遥测场景下的三大技能学习痛点，在多个基准上显著优于现有基线，且训练token消耗仅为在线验证的1/5到1/75，技能引导进度指标还能与在线成功率对齐，具备很高的实用价值。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 该工作通过实证揭示了多模态自主研究中普遍存在的性能回归和模型选择缺陷，为后续研究提供了重要基准，但未深入探讨如何设计更鲁棒的迭代改进策略以避免非目标能力下降问题。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Yuxin Liu, Yuxuan Wang, Zhenxin Lei, Lingchen Meng, Yuchong Sun, Junming Lin, Hongcheng Liu, Yunfei Chu, Qize Yang, Jin Xu, Lei Zhang, Zhendong Mao 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.WorkingMemory 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 17:32:58 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05398 🔗 触发的灵感来源： SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents, ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization, How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?, VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks, SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching, From Given to Gathered Evidence: Agentic Learning for Longitudinal Medical Reasoning 🔄 深度差量对比： 与以往研究不同，本文聚焦于多模态任务中 LLM 智能体的自主研究能力，特别是后训练阶段的模型改进与选择问题，而不仅是单一模态或特定任务。 🧠 核心术语库 [[MMPostTrainBench]] [[Autonomous research]] [[Multimodal post-training]] [[Development feedback]] [[Hierarchical memory]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 随着 LLM 智能体处理多模态任务，其自主研究能力在长周期任务中面临挑战。该论文发现现有智能体在多模态后训练研究中存在性能下降和模型选择失误问题，核心思想是构建 MMPostTrainBench 基准测试，分析并解决多模态任务中自主研究能力的局限性。 🔬 Method 提出 MMPostTrainBench 基准测试，包含图像、音频、视频及联合理解等八项任务。智能体在固定预算内使用开发反馈迭代改进模型，最终提交模型进行独立评估。评估指标涵盖目标与非目标模型结果、迭代改进效果和科研诚信。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 该工作通过实证揭示了多模态自主研究中普遍存在的性能回归和模型选择缺陷，为后续研究提供了重要基准，但未深入探讨如何设计更鲁棒的迭代改进策略以避免非目标能力下降问题。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 本文创新性地将模型后训练与agent harness的演化优化深度绑定，通过证书驱动机制实现了研究级证明自动形式化的精度与成本双突破，但当前框架的场景适配性仍局限于数学证明领域，对其他领域的形式化任务泛化能力有待验证。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Prithwish Jana, Viet Bach Hoang, Logan Luna, Viresh Pati, Akash Singirikonda, Cy Xie, Lisa Carbone, Wuyang Chen, Walter Moreira, Joe Stubbs, Sriram Vishwanath, Vijay Ganesh 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.UsePlanning 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 16:48:12 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05367 🔗 触发的灵感来源： A Kinetic Theory of the Gated Self-Evolving LLM Agent, From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence, SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中聚焦通用LLM agent自进化理论、源特定记忆获取、无奖励自我改进的论文相比，本论文聚焦数学证明自动形式化场景，核心是联合模型后训练与agent harness的证书驱动演化，应用场景与核心优化对象均不重叠，仅在均涉及agent迭代优化机制上存在共性。 🧠 核心术语库 [[AIProver]] [[HarnessEvolve]] [[Auto-Formalization]] [[Proof Synthesis]] [[LoCoBench]] [[Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search]] [[Symbolic Feedback]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有研究级数学证明自动形式化工作存在三大核心瓶颈：一是研究级证明依赖的领域概念常缺失于主流证明助手库（如Lean Mathlib），二是编译成功的形式化结果无法保证语义正确性与推理逻辑保留，三是高对齐质量的自然语言-形式语言训练数据稀缺，且现有方案依赖昂贵前沿模型与手工设计的agent执行框架。该问题的研究价值在于，研究级证明的自动形式化是推动数学研究自动化、实现证明可机械验证的核心基础，突破现有瓶颈可大幅降低形式化证明的成本。核心思想是提出AIProver框架，联合后训练开源大语言模型与证书驱动的agent harness演化机制，通过验证器输出的类型正确性、证明完整性与语义正确性奖励及诊断证书，同时驱动模型微调与harness控制流的迭代优化，实现精度与成本的最优平衡。 🔬 Method AIProver首先对119B开源权重语言模型进行后训练，使其适配证明自动形式化任务需求。其次设计多维度验证器，同时评估形式化结果的类型正确性、证明完整性与语义正确性，返回对应奖励与诊断证书。接着采用交替优化流程：一方面用符号反馈驱动模型的强化学习微调，另一方面通过HarnessEvolve对agent的工具调用harness进行证书驱动的演化搜索，重新适配更新后的模型控制流。最后构建LoCoBench基准，涵盖Mathlib、CSLib等多个来源的5.89万条实例，用于模型训练与效果评估。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 本文创新性地将模型后训练与agent harness的演化优化深度绑定，通过证书驱动机制实现了研究级证明自动形式化的精度与成本双突破，但当前框架的场景适配性仍局限于数学证明领域，对其他领域的形式化任务泛化能力有待验证。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 本文创新性地解决了在线测试时训练直接模仿单次轨迹导致策略失稳的核心痛点，通过无外部参考的自蒸馏实现验证经验的权重固化，在多基准上验证了跨任务迁移的有效性，但未深入分析不同任务流分布下经验蒸馏的泛化边界与稳定性限制。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Haodong Lu, Dong Gong 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.Consolidation 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 15:27:20 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05303 🔗 触发的灵感来源： A Kinetic Theory of the Gated Self-Evolving LLM Agent, From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence, Sharpening Tax in Post-Training 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中聚焦技能更新门控接受策略设计的SAGE论文相比，SAGE通过门控机制筛选可接受的技能更新，而ASCENT通过自蒸馏将验证过的执行经验直接固化到模型权重，无需技能检索与门控筛选环节，是经验权重巩固与技能门控接受两条不同的自进化实现路径。 🧠 核心术语库 [[ASCENT]] [[Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT)]] [[Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time]] [[LoRA fast weights]] [[Verified Experience Self-Distillation]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有基于上下文适应的LLM agent将反思、记忆、技能以文本形式存储，依赖检索匹配和冻结策略执行，无法将验证过的执行经验直接固化到模型权重中，难以实现跨任务的持续性能提升。直接对在线测试时采集的单次执行轨迹进行模仿或强化学习更新，会导致策略失稳，无法有效利用终端验证信号。核心思想是提出ASCENT框架，通过自蒸馏将验证过的执行经验从冻结的初始模型迁移到持久化的LoRA快速权重中，无需外部参考模型或独立训练阶段即可实现经验的权重固化，同时通过移除无效动作回合优化蒸馏效率。 🔬 Method ASCENT面向在线智能体测试时训练场景，要求agent仅对每个任务执行一次，以带终端验证信号的执行轨迹作为权重更新的唯一学习信号。核心设计是保留agent的初始冻结副本作为稳定基准，将验证通过的轨迹作为特权信息，让冻结模型基于该hindsight预测轨迹上的下一个token分布。通过自蒸馏将这些预测的分布迁移到持久化的LoRA快速权重中，完成对后续任务有用的权重更新，无需外部参考解或更强的教师模型。进一步通过移除包含无效动作的执行回合，优化蒸馏所用的特权经验质量，提升执行效率。最终在ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld三个基准、不同模型规模上验证了方法的有效性。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 本文创新性地解决了在线测试时训练直接模仿单次轨迹导致策略失稳的核心痛点，通过无外部参考的自蒸馏实现验证经验的权重固化，在多基准上验证了跨任务迁移的有效性，但未深入分析不同任务流分布下经验蒸馏的泛化边界与稳定性限制。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: AECG: Asymmetric Experience Consolidation and Governance In Multi-Agent Systems
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: AECG创新性地将记忆治理从被动存储提升为主动可靠性管理，在12个设置中获得11个最佳成绩，范围保留移除后准确率下降16.89个百分点，证明了协调范围保护的核心价值，为多智能体记忆系统提供了新范式。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: AECG: Asymmetric Experience Consolidation and Governance In Multi-Agent Systems 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Ao Tian, Jialong Liu, Daqi Zheng, Xin Sun, Mengting Li, Zhizhao Xiao, Zijian Huang, Honglei Wang, Zijian Hei, Yukun Yan 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： Unclassified 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 12:38:03 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05176 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S, MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory, Decoupling Memory from Context: Structured Memory for Token-Efficient Test-Time Continual Learning, Persistent Context Graphs for Efficient Memory Compaction in LLM Agents, VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks 🔄 深度差量对比： 与ReCAP和MemFit等侧重记忆压缩/存储效率的论文不同，AECG专注于记忆污染治理和范围保护，通过动态可靠性评估而非静态压缩来提升记忆质量。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Memory Pollution]] [[Scope Collapse]] [[Asymmetric Experience Consolidation]] [[Reliability Governance]] [[Coordination Scope Preservation]] [[Paired Replay]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 多智能体系统中，记忆污染（过时/弱支持的程序被反复使用）和范围崩溃（程序知识逃离有效协调范围）是关键挑战。现有记忆系统将记忆视为静态存储，导致错误持久化且难以追踪。该论文提出AECG框架，将记忆从被动积累转变为动态可靠性治理循环，通过保留协调范围和多尺度置信度感知来检测退化，从而优先处理高风险知识。 🔬 Method AECG构建了非对称经验整合与治理框架，包含四个核心组件：1）多尺度置信度感知的可靠性检测，用于识别记忆退化；2）协调范围保留机制，防止程序知识跨越有效决策层级扩散；3）基于下游影响和退化程度的有界审查预算优先排序；4）针对性干预与成对重放后的技能重新激活。推理时系统评估记忆可靠性并选择性激活治理流程。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review AECG创新性地将记忆治理从被动存储提升为主动可靠性管理，在12个设置中获得11个最佳成绩，范围保留移除后准确率下降16.89个百分点，证明了协调范围保护的核心价值，为多智能体记忆系统提供了新范式。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: CIPO 提供了直观的粒度选择训练信号，有效避免了单纯增加技能频率，实现了在精细控制与高层抽象间的高效切换。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Yu Li, Yunlu Wan, Zijian Zhu, Han Luo, Chao Ren, Long-Fei Li, Lei Feng 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Skill.ExecutionSelection 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 06:20:50 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04991 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation, Passing the Test You Trained On: Re-evaluating Prompt-Injection Detectors for LLM Agents, InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中关注技能发现或迁移的论文不同，CIPO 聚焦于 Agent 内部执行层面，解决了原子工具与复合技能共存时的粒度选择决策问题。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization]] [[Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection]] [[Composite Skills]] [[Atomic Tools]] [[Counterfactual Branch Rollout]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea LLM agents 在与工具交互时经常重复局部工具序列，将其抽象为复合技能可提升效率，但原子工具与技能共存时的粒度选择（精细控制与高层抽象）成为关键难题。CIPO 将有效技能使用视为自适应工具粒度选择问题，核心思想是通过反事实分支 rollout，利用同状态下原子与技能选择的后果差异作为训练信号，优化粒度决策。 🔬 Method CIPO 通过预算受限挖掘成功轨迹来构建可执行技能库。在推理时，CIPO 在第一个符合条件的粒度决策点进行反事实分支 rollout，将原始动作替换为可行的原子或技能替代方案，并将成对结果差异作为补充奖励来优化策略。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review CIPO 提供了直观的粒度选择训练信号，有效避免了单纯增加技能频率，实现了在精细控制与高层抽象间的高效切换。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 本文首次系统化了MLE任务中insight的获取与注入流程，大规模实验验证了insight提升123.9%的显著效果，并揭示了skill与playbook两种注入方式的互补性，为agentic MLE的知识复用提供了坚实基准和方法论指导。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Bihui Jin, Yinxi Li, Kaiyuan Wang, Pengyu Nie 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： Unclassified 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 04:10:28 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04927 🔗 触发的灵感来源： How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?, KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora, SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching, MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills, SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中SkillFM、SkillCome等技能发现方法相比，本工作聚焦于从真实竞赛中系统化提取insight并评估不同注入方式的效果，明确区分了领域知识、竞赛特定方案和通用调试策略三种insight类型。 🧠 核心术语库 [[agentic MLE]] [[insight assembly]] [[MLE-InsightBench]] [[MLE-InsightForge]] [[domain insight]] [[competition insight]] [[improvement insight]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 当前agentic MLE系统中insight的收集与注入缺乏系统化方法，且评估中存在数据泄漏风险导致有效性受损。论文核心思想是构建系统化的insight获取与注入框架，通过从大量相关MLE任务中提取领域知识、竞赛方案和通用优化策略，为agent提供可复用的经验知识。 🔬 Method 研究者提出MLE-InsightBench基准，包含160个Kaggle竞赛按领域划分，并设计MLE-InsightForge agent探索源竞赛、人类解决方案和writeups，构建三类insight：12个domain insights、148个competition insights和16个improvement insights。实验中将insight以on-demand skills或upfront playbook两种方式注入，在160个目标竞赛上验证效果。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 本文首次系统化了MLE任务中insight的获取与注入流程，大规模实验验证了insight提升123.9%的显著效果，并揭示了skill与playbook两种注入方式的互补性，为agentic MLE的知识复用提供了坚实基准和方法论指导。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: ForkPilot 通过 SVD 量化回溯搜索的权衡，有效解决了长时序代理中的复杂度挑战，在大幅降低 token 使用量的同时保持了高成功率。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: ForkPilot: Self-Evolving Policy for Retrospective Search in Long-Horizon Agents 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 👤 作者： Xinyue Zeng, Shivam Shandilya, Guilherme Potje, Leonardo Nunes, Rakshanda Agarwal, Ranveer Chandra, Emre Kiciman, Dawei Zhou, Tusher Chakraborty 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Experience.Reflection 🕒 发布时间： 2026-10-04 02:53:58 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04889 🔗 触发的灵感来源： InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation, ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization, SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents 🔄 深度差量对比： 与 SelfSearch 侧重于利用无奖励历史进行搜索不同，ForkPilot 专注于解决长时序代理中回溯搜索特有的归因与适应复杂度问题，强调搜索决策策略的自我进化。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Search Value Dynamics (SVD)]] [[Retrospective Search]] [[Self-Evolving Policy]] [[Attribution Complexity]] [[Adaptation Complexity]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 长时序语言模型代理在多步工具交互中面临错误累积，回溯搜索虽能恢复但易分配不当。延迟结果导致归因复杂度，演化证据导致适应复杂度。核心思想是引入搜索价值动态 (SVD) 来刻画搜索的收益与成本权衡，并提出 ForkPilot 两阶段自进化策略框架。 🔬 Method ForkPilot 包含两个阶段：第一阶段从完成的轨迹中离线学习搜索价值策略；第二阶段基于当前观察进行搜索决策，并通过自我进化整合新轨迹以更新策略。该方法利用 Search Value Dynamics (SVD) 动态评估搜索必要性，在 6 个基准和 7 种 LLM 骨干上验证，显著降低了 token 使用量。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review ForkPilot 通过 SVD 量化回溯搜索的权衡，有效解决了长时序代理中的复杂度挑战，在大幅降低 token 使用量的同时保持了高成功率。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: Do Agent Societies Develop Intellectual Elites? The Hidden Power Laws of Collective Cognition in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该文极具洞察力，跳出了单纯追求SOTA的工程陷阱，转而从复杂系统动力学视角审视多智能体系统的‘扩展悖论’。其发现的‘智力精英’与‘集成瓶颈’现象，深刻揭示了随规模增长而产生的结构性脆弱——即规模扩大带来的信息熵增与系统整合能力之间的非对称错配。这不仅是实证研究，更是为领域建立了新的理论范式，将研究重心从‘显性性能’引向了‘隐式结构’，对后续设计可扩展、鲁棒的多智能体架构具有奠基意义。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: Do Agent Societies Develop Intellectual Elites? The Hidden Power Laws of Collective Cognition in LLM Multi-Agent Systems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Kavana Venkatesh, Jiaming Cui 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-03 03:08:07 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02674v1 🧾 一句话总结： 首次通过大规模实证揭示了多智能体系统集体认知的幂律分布与结构性瓶颈，为解决规模化收益递减问题提供了坚实的理论基础与创新路径。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM) multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed as interacting agent societies, yet scaling these systems often yields diminishing or unstable returns, the causes of which remain poorly understood. We present the first large-scale empirical study of coordination dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, introducing an atomic event-level formulation that reconstructs reasoning as cascades of coordination. Analyzing over 1.5 Million interactions across tasks, topologies, and scales, we uncover three coupled laws: coordination follows heavy-tailed cascades, concentrates via preferential attachment into intellectual elites, and produces increasingly frequent extreme events as system size grows. We show that these effects are coupled through a single structural mechanism: an integration bottleneck, in which coordination expansion scales with system size while consolidation does not, producing large but weakly integrated reasoning processes. To test this mechanism, we introduce Deficit-Triggered Integration (DTI), which selectively increases integration under imbalance. DTI improves performance precisely where coordination fails, without suppressing large-scale reasoning. Together, our results establish quantitative laws of collective cognition and identify coordination structure as a fundamental, previously unmeasured axis for understanding and improving scalable multi-agent intelligence. 🧠 核心术语库 [[原子事件级公式]] [[智力精英]] [[集成瓶颈]] [[偏好依附]] [[缺陷触发集成(DTI)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出原子事件级公式重构推理过程，基于跨任务、拓扑和规模的150万次交互数据进行大规模实证分析，揭示了集体认知的幂律定律，定位了‘集成瓶颈’机制，并提出缺陷触发集成（DTI）算法进行验证。 💬 锐评 该文极具洞察力，跳出了单纯追求SOTA的工程陷阱，转而从复杂系统动力学视角审视多智能体系统的‘扩展悖论’。其发现的‘智力精英’与‘集成瓶颈’现象，深刻揭示了随规模增长而产生的结构性脆弱——即规模扩大带来的信息熵增与系统整合能力之间的非对称错配。这不仅是实证研究，更是为领域建立了新的理论范式，将研究重心从‘显性性能’引向了‘隐式结构’，对后续设计可扩展、鲁棒的多智能体架构具有奠基意义。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: Efficient LLM Safety Evaluation through Multi-Agent Debate
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该工作精准打击了LLM安全评估中强模型成本过高的痛点，通过多智能体辩论机制巧妙地挖掘了小模型的潜力，具有很高的工程应用价值。然而，该方法引入的多轮推理虽然降低了API调用成本，但增加了Token消耗和推理延迟，在超大规模实时评估场景下的吞吐量仍存疑；此外，小模型固有的语义理解局限可能使其在面对复杂逻辑陷阱时仍难以通过简单辩论完全纠正。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: Efficient LLM Safety Evaluation through Multi-Agent Debate 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Dachuan Lin, Guobin Shen, Zihao Yang, Tianrong Liu, Dongcheng Zhao, Yi Zeng 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-11-09 14:06:55 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.06396v3 🧾 一句话总结： 提出一种基于多智能体辩论的安全评估框架，结合新基准HAJailBench，在大幅降低成本的同时有效提升了小模型作为评判者的可靠性。 📄 摘要： Safety evaluation of large language models (LLMs) increasingly relies on LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, but strong judges can still be expensive to use at scale. We study whether structured multi-agent debate can improve judge reliability while keeping backbone size and cost modest. To do so, we introduce HAJailBench, a human-annotated jailbreak benchmark with 11,100 labeled interactions spanning diverse attack methods and target models, and we pair it with a Multi-Agent Judge framework in which critic, defender, and judge agents debate under a shared safety rubric. On HAJailBench, the framework improves over matched small-model prompt baselines and prior multi-agent judges, while remaining more economical than GPT-4o under the evaluated pricing snapshot. Ablation results further show that a small number of debate rounds is sufficient to capture most of the gain. Together, these results support structured, value-aligned debate as a practical design for scalable LLM safety evaluation. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LLM-as-a-judge]] [[Multi-Agent Debate]] [[Safety Evaluation]] [[HAJailBench]] [[Jailbreak]] 🔬 核心方法简述 引入包含11,100条人类标注交互的越狱基准HAJailBench，并设计了一个Multi-Agent Judge框架，让批评者、防御者和评判者三个智能体基于共享安全准则进行结构化辩论，旨在以较小规模的模型和成本实现接近GPT-4o级别的评估可靠性。 💬 锐评 该工作精准打击了LLM安全评估中强模型成本过高的痛点，通过多智能体辩论机制巧妙地挖掘了小模型的潜力，具有很高的工程应用价值。然而，该方法引入的多轮推理虽然降低了API调用成本，但增加了Token消耗和推理延迟，在超大规模实时评估场景下的吞吐量仍存疑；此外，小模型固有的语义理解局限可能使其在面对复杂逻辑陷阱时仍难以通过简单辩论完全纠正。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: SwarmSys: Decentralized Swarm-Inspired Agents for Scalable and Adaptive Reasoning
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该论文创新性地将群集智能引入LLM推理，通过‘探索-开发-验证’的循环打破了传统固定角色的局限，显著提升了长跨度任务的鲁棒性。其分布式协调机制为解决多智能体协作中的‘扩展性瓶颈’提供了新范式，但需关注大规模通信开销及收敛速度的潜在挑战。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: SwarmSys: Decentralized Swarm-Inspired Agents for Scalable and Adaptive Reasoning 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Ruohao Li, Hongjun Liu, Leyi Zhao, Zisu Li, Jiawei Li, Jiajun Jiang, Linning Xu, Chen Zhao, Mingming Fan, Chen Liang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-10-11 06:28:22 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10047v1 🧾 一句话总结： SwarmSys通过群集智能启发的分布式循环机制，实现了无需全局监督的可扩展且自适应的多智能体推理。 📄 摘要： Large language model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable reasoning abilities. However, existing multi-agent frameworks often rely on fixed roles or centralized control, limiting scalability and adaptability in long-horizon reasoning. We introduce SwarmSys, a closed-loop framework for distributed multi-agent reasoning inspired by swarm intelligence. Coordination in SwarmSys emerges through iterative interactions among three specialized roles, Explorers, Workers, and Validators, that continuously cycle through exploration, exploitation, and validation. To enable scalable and adaptive collaboration, we integrate adaptive agent and event profiles, embedding-based probabilistic matching, and a pheromone-inspired reinforcement mechanism, supporting dynamic task allocation and self-organizing convergence without global supervision. Across symbolic reasoning, research synthesis, and scientific programming tasks, SwarmSys consistently outperforms baselines, improving both accuracy and reasoning stability. These findings highlight swarm-inspired coordination as a promising paradigm for scalable, robust, and adaptive multi-agent reasoning, suggesting that coordination scaling may rival model scaling in advancing LLM intelligence. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Swarm Intelligence (群集智能)]] [[Decentralized Coordination (分布式协调)]] [[Explorers/Workers/Validators (探索者/工作者/验证者)]] [[Pheromone-inspired Reinforcement (受信息素启发的强化)]] [[Adaptive Agent Profiles (自适应智能体档案)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 基于群集智能的分布式闭环框架，包含探索者、工作者、验证者三个角色循环（探索-开发-验证），利用自适应档案、嵌入匹配及信息素强化机制实现动态任务分配与自组织收敛，无需全局监督。 💬 锐评 该论文创新性地将群集智能引入LLM推理，通过‘探索-开发-验证’的循环打破了传统固定角色的局限，显著提升了长跨度任务的鲁棒性。其分布式协调机制为解决多智能体协作中的‘扩展性瓶颈’提供了新范式，但需关注大规模通信开销及收敛速度的潜在挑战。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: CREW-WILDFIRE: Benchmarking Agentic Multi-Agent Collaborations at Scale
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该论文通过构建一个更接近真实世界的复杂动态环境，揭示了现有LLM多智能体框架在大规模协调、通信、空间推理和不确定性下的长时程规划方面的显著性能差距，为该领域的研究指明了方向。然而，论文未深入探讨如何解决这些挑战，例如如何设计更有效的通信协议或更鲁棒的规划算法。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: CREW-WILDFIRE: Benchmarking Agentic Multi-Agent Collaborations at Scale 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Jonathan Hyun, Nicholas R Waytowich, Boyuan Chen 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-07-07 16:33:42 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05178v2 🧾 一句话总结： CREW-Wildfire为评估大规模多智能体协作的可扩展性、鲁棒性和协调能力提供了一个更真实、更具挑战性的基准测试环境，揭示了现有LLM框架的不足，为未来研究提供了重要基础。 📄 摘要： Despite rapid progress in large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, current benchmarks fall short in evaluating their scalability, robustness, and coordination capabilities in complex, dynamic, real-world tasks. Existing environments typically focus on small-scale, fully observable, or low-complexity domains, limiting their utility for developing and assessing next-generation multi-agent Agentic AI frameworks. We introduce CREW-Wildfire, an open-source benchmark designed to close this gap. Built atop the human-AI teaming CREW simulation platform, CREW-Wildfire offers procedurally generated wildfire response scenarios featuring large maps, heterogeneous agents, partial observability, stochastic dynamics, and long-horizon planning objectives. The environment supports both low-level control and high-level natural language interactions through modular Perception and Execution modules. We implement and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLM-based multi-agent Agentic AI frameworks, uncovering significant performance gaps that highlight the unsolved challenges in large-scale coordination, communication, spatial reasoning, and long-horizon planning under uncertainty. By providing more realistic complexity, scalable architecture, and behavioral evaluation metrics, CREW-Wildfire establishes a critical foundation for advancing research in scalable multi-agent Agentic intelligence. All code, environments, data, and baselines will be released to support future research in this emerging domain. 🧠 核心术语库 [[CREW-Wildfire基准测试]] [[多智能体协作]] [[部分可观察性]] [[随机动态]] [[长时程规划]] 🔬 核心方法简述 基于CREW模拟平台，设计了一个名为CREW-Wildfire的基准测试环境，通过程序化生成大规模、异构智能体、部分可观察性、随机动态和长时程规划的野火响应场景，评估LLM多智能体协作的可扩展性、鲁棒性和协调能力。 💬 锐评 该论文通过构建一个更接近真实世界的复杂动态环境，揭示了现有LLM多智能体框架在大规模协调、通信、空间推理和不确定性下的长时程规划方面的显著性能差距，为该领域的研究指明了方向。然而，论文未深入探讨如何解决这些挑战，例如如何设计更有效的通信协议或更鲁棒的规划算法。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: CodeAgents: A Token-Efficient Framework for Codified Multi-Agent Reasoning in LLMs
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该工作创新性地将伪代码编码范式引入多智能体提示领域，在性能提升与token效率优化上均有显著成果，但局限明显：一是伪代码规范仅适配规划类任务，对开放域动态多智能体协同场景的适配性未做验证；二是未给出伪代码编写的标准化流程，落地时的额外编码成本未被量化评估；三是仅与自然语言提示基线对比，未与AutoGen、MetaGPT等成熟多智能体框架做系统性对标，效率优势的普适性存疑。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: CodeAgents: A Token-Efficient Framework for Codified Multi-Agent Reasoning in LLMs 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Bruce Yang, Xinfeng He, Huan Gao, Yifan Cao, Xiaofan Li, David Hsu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-07-04 02:20:19 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.03254v1 🧾 一句话总结： 本文提出CodeAgents编码化多智能体推理框架，通过模块化伪代码规范多智能体全交互流程，在提升多智能体规划性能的同时大幅降低token消耗，为高可扩展、高token效率的多智能体LLM系统提供了新型提示范式。 📄 摘要： Effective prompt design is essential for improving the planning capabilities of large language model (LLM)-driven agents. However, existing structured prompting strategies are typically limited to single-agent, plan-only settings, and often evaluate performance solely based on task accuracy - overlooking critical factors such as token efficiency, modularity, and scalability in multi-agent environments. To address these limitations, we introduce CodeAgents, a prompting framework that codifies multi-agent reasoning and enables structured, token-efficient planning in multi-agent systems. In CodeAgents, all components of agent interaction - Task, Plan, Feedback, system roles, and external tool invocations - are codified into modular pseudocode enriched with control structures (e.g., loops, conditionals), boolean logic, and typed variables. This design transforms loosely connected agent plans into cohesive, interpretable, and verifiable multi-agent reasoning programs. We evaluate the proposed framework across three diverse benchmarks - GAIA, HotpotQA, and VirtualHome - using a range of representative LLMs. Results show consistent improvements in planning performance, with absolute gains of 3-36 percentage points over natural language prompting baselines. On VirtualHome, our method achieves a new state-of-the-art success rate of 56%. In addition, our approach reduces input and output token usage by 55-87% and 41-70%, respectively, underscoring the importance of token-aware evaluation metrics in the development of scalable multi-agent LLM systems. To address these challenges, we develop several new features and components for AgentScope, a user-friendly multi-agent platform, enhancing its convenience and flexibility for supporting very large-scale multi-agent simulations. MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: LongAgent: Scaling Language Models to 128k Context through Multi-Agent Collaboration
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该工作巧妙利用多智能体协作的“分布式”特性绕过了单模型长上下文窗口的硬性限制，并针对协作中的幻觉冲突提出了通信缓解机制。然而，从效率和鲁棒性角度来看，引入数十至数百个Agent进行通信必然导致推理延迟和Token消耗剧增，摘要中未体现对这种高通信开销的评估；此外，依赖Leader从充满幻觉的成员响应中聚合信息，在面对更深层次的复杂逻辑推理时，系统鲁棒性可能面临严峻挑战。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: LongAgent: Scaling Language Models to 128k Context through Multi-Agent Collaboration 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Jun Zhao, Can Zu, Hao Xu, Yi Lu, Wei He, Yiwen Ding, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-02-18 11:46:52 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.11550v2 🧾 一句话总结： 提出基于Leader-Member架构和成员间通信机制的LongAgent，通过小模型多智能体协作低成本处理128k长文本，在检索和多跳问答任务上展现出超越GPT-4的潜力。 📄 摘要： Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in understanding language and executing complex reasoning tasks. However, LLMs with long context windows have been notorious for their expensive training costs and high inference latency. Even the most advanced models such as GPT-4 and Claude2 often make mistakes when processing inputs of over $100k$ tokens, a phenomenon also known as \textit{lost in the middle}. In this paper, we propose \textsc{LongAgent}, a method based on multi-agent collaboration, which scales LLMs (e.g., LLaMA) to a context of 128K and demonstrates potential superiority in long-text processing compared to GPT-4. In \textsc{LongAgent}, a leader is responsible for understanding user intent and directing team members to acquire information from documents. Due to members' hallucinations, it is non-trivial for a leader to obtain accurate information from the responses of dozens to hundreds of members. To address this, we develop an \textit{inter-member communication} mechanism to resolve response conflicts caused by hallucinations through information sharing. Our experimental results indicate that \textsc{LongAgent} offers a promising alternative for long-text processing. The agent team instantiated with LLaMA-7B achieves significant improvements in tasks such as 128k-long text retrieval, multi-hop question answering, compared to GPT-4. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Multi-Agent Collaboration]] [[Leader-Member Architecture]] [[Inter-member Communication]] [[Lost in the middle]] [[Hallucination Mitigation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 采用Leader-Member多智能体架构处理长文本，Leader负责理解意图并分配任务，Member负责从文档获取信息；针对成员幻觉导致的信息冲突，设计了成员间通信机制，通过信息共享解决冲突以提取准确信息，从而实现用小模型（如LLaMA-7B）协作处理128k上下文。 💬 锐评 该工作巧妙利用多智能体协作的“分布式”特性绕过了单模型长上下文窗口的硬性限制，并针对协作中的幻觉冲突提出了通信缓解机制。然而，从效率和鲁棒性角度来看，引入数十至数百个Agent进行通信必然导致推理延迟和Token消耗剧增，摘要中未体现对这种高通信开销的评估；此外，依赖Leader从充满幻觉的成员响应中聚合信息，在面对更深层次的复杂逻辑推理时，系统鲁棒性可能面临严峻挑战。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.title: Towards Autonomous Formulaic Alpha Discovery: An Evolutionary Computation Perspective
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 该文是领域集大成之作，敏锐捕捉到当前Alpha发现研究中GP、RL、GFlowNets、LLM等方法论割裂的痛点，首次以演化计算为'元语言'统一了异构算法家族。其提出的'演化自主性'极具前瞻性，直指从人工调参向自适应系统进阶的必然趋势。然而，将LLM智能体等生成式模型强行纳入传统EC的'表示-变异'框架可能存在颗粒度不匹配的理论风险（如LLM的隐式变异算子难以被传统框架完全解释），这一统一视角的有效性取决于能否切实指导跨范式组件的底层融合，而非仅仅提供一种分类学的快感。
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.full_note: Towards Autonomous Formulaic Alpha Discovery: An Evolutionary Computation Perspective 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure 👤 作者： Xinwei Yu, Yiyang Fu, Mingcheng Fan, Enqi Li, Yilin Gao, Shugong Xu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 07:02:24 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01789v1 🧾 一句话总结： 作为首篇从演化计算视角统一自动化Alpha发现方法的理论综述，通过六组件分析与八维评估体系，为构建可靠、自适应、可解释的自主发现系统奠定了系统性的理论基石。 📄 摘要： Automated formulaic alpha discovery aims to generate predictive and interpretable trading signals from large symbolic factor spaces. Its effectiveness is constrained by noisy fitness estimates, market nonstationarity, costly backtesting, semantic redundancy, and conflicting practical objectives. Existing studies employ diverse techniques, including genetic programming (GP), evolutionary algorithms (EAs), reinforcement learning (RL), generative flow networks (GFlowNets), Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), large language models (LLMs), and agentic workflows, but generally examine them as separate algorithmic families. This article introduces, for the first time, a unified evolutionary computation (EC) perspective on automated formulaic alpha discovery, formulating it as a noisy, dynamic, and multiobjective symbolic evolutionary optimization problem. A six-component analytical framework is developed to characterize existing methods through representation, variation, fitness evaluation, selection, memory, and adaptation. Furthermore, an eight-dimensional, autonomy-oriented evaluation framework is proposed, covering search efficiency, fitness reliability, residual alpha quality, economic diversity, tradability, evolutionary autonomy, robustness to nonstationarity, and reproducibility. Together, these frameworks provide a systematic foundation for unifying heterogeneous approaches, diagnosing component-level limitations, and guiding the development of reliable, adaptive, interpretable, and reproducible autonomous alpha discovery systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Formulaic Alpha Discovery]] [[Unified Evolutionary Computation Perspective]] [[Six-component Analytical Framework]] [[Evolutionary Autonomy]] [[Noisy Dynamic Multi-objective Optimization]] [[Semantic Redundancy]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出统一演化计算（EC）视角，将自动化公式化Alpha发现重构为噪声、动态、多目标的符号演化优化问题；构建了包含表示、变异、适应度评估、选择、记忆、适应的六组件分析框架，以及涵盖搜索效率、适应度可靠性、演化自主性等八维度的自主性评估体系。 💬 锐评 该文是领域集大成之作，敏锐捕捉到当前Alpha发现研究中GP、RL、GFlowNets、LLM等方法论割裂的痛点，首次以演化计算为'元语言'统一了异构算法家族。其提出的'演化自主性'极具前瞻性，直指从人工调参向自适应系统进阶的必然趋势。然而，将LLM智能体等生成式模型强行纳入传统EC的'表示-变异'框架可能存在颗粒度不匹配的理论风险（如LLM的隐式变异算子难以被传统框架完全解释），这一统一视角的有效性取决于能否切实指导跨范式组件的底层融合，而非仅仅提供一种分类学的快感。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Casas, Nelson L. S. da Fonseca, and Carlos A. Astudillo 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 03:40:09 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01649v1 🧾 一句话总结： 该研究利用LLM与仿真反馈闭环实现了RL路由奖励的自动化设计，在无需人工调优的情况下达到了接近专家水平的性能，为动态网络环境下的智能体优化提供了高效工具。 📄 摘要： Routing in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks is challenging due to highly dynamic topologies and spatio-temporal network conditions. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for adaptive routing; however, its performance critically depends on reward function design, which must balance objectives such as goodput and end-to-end delay. In practice, reward design remains a complex manual process requiring significant domain expertise and extensive trial-and-error. Recent works have explored Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated reward design, but their application to highly dynamic systems such as LEO satellite networks remains largely unexplored. We propose LARGE, a framework that automates reward design for RL-based routing by combining LLM- driven generation with iterative simulator-in-the-loop evaluation. LARGE generates an initial reward from LLM prior knowledge and iteratively refines it using simulation feedback. This loop enables exploration of diverse reward formulations while aligning them with network objectives. Results show that LARGE improves reward quality within a few iterations through feedback-driven refinement. Across different backbones, the framework achieves performance comparable to an expert-designed baseline, with the best-performing configuration reaching goodput within approximately 3% of the baseline and slightly lower end-to-end delay, without manual reward engineering. These results indicate that effectiveness emerges from the iterative feedback-driven process enabled by LARGE, highlighting the potential of framework-driven LLM-in-the-loop optimization for RL-based routing in dynamic satellite networks. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LEO卫星网络路由]] [[强化学习 (RL)]] [[自动奖励设计]] [[LLM-in-the-loop]] [[迭代反馈优化]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出LARGE框架，结合LLM的先验知识生成初始奖励函数，通过仿真器在环（simulator-in-the-loop）进行评估，利用反馈机制迭代优化奖励设计，无需人工干预即可适应LEO卫星网络的动态环境。 💬 锐评 尽管LARGE在吞吐量上仅达到专家基线的约97%，未能实现全面超越，但其在高度动态的卫星网络场景中验证了LLM替代人工进行复杂奖励工程的可能性；其核心价值在于通过“生成-评估-反馈”的闭环机制解决了RL落地中的冷启动与调优瓶颈，然而其对仿真环境的依赖性以及从仿真到真实场景的迁移风险仍需关注。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.title: Securing Agentic AI: From Per-Action Checks to Trajectory Assurance
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 作为冷启动阶段的综述，本文精准击中了当前代理安全研究的痛点：即‘局部正确性陷阱’。它深刻指出了单纯依赖Prompt Engineering或单次行动检查的局限性，明确安全应被视为一种架构级属性而非可选层。其批判性在于揭示了多代理协作中信任与控制的复杂性，但也存在不足：侧重于宏观架构描述，缺乏具体实现轨迹保证的技术细节（如形式化验证或可执行计划）。
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.full_note: Securing Agentic AI: From Per-Action Checks to Trajectory Assurance 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure 👤 作者： Alireza Lotfi, Subangkar Karmaker Shanto, Imtiaz Karim, Elisa Bertino 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 00:28:49 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01558v1 🧾 一句话总结： 本文通过分析代理安全的演进，提出将安全重心从单次行动检查升级为轨迹级保证，为可信自主代理的部署提供了关键路线图。 📄 摘要： Autonomous agents are increasingly used to execute consequential tasks in environments governed by operational constraints, organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and technical standards. Their safety is therefore determined not by the correctness of individual actions, but by whether their overall behavior remains consistent with the rules and invariants of the systems in which they operate. As large language model (LLM)-based agents become more autonomous and increasingly delegate tasks across organizational boundaries, securing them evolves from a single challenge into a broad and interconnected landscape spanning the entire agentic stack. At the single-agent level, untrusted inputs through prompts, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool interfaces create attack surfaces. In multi-agent settings, delegation and communication introduce challenges related to identity, trust, capability control, and decision transparency, while the underlying model routing and execution control plane remains vulnerable to manipulation and to unverified model provenance. Perhaps the most fundamental challenge is behavioral containment: sequences of individually permissible actions may collectively violate system-level constraints and safety invariants. At the broader level, supply-chain integrity, provenance, accountability, and end-to-end observability remain largely open problems. A common principle unifies these directions: security must become a verifiable property of the architectures, protocols, and runtimes that govern agent behavior, rather than an optional layer of guidance. This expanded attack surface remains poorly understood and inadequately categorized. We evaluate three adversarial scenarios, across three conditions (baseline, prompt-hardened, and reasoning-enabled), including a novel MAS-specific Telephone Loop attack that exploits cross-agent delegation to create cyclical task loops. The attack is inert against SAS but compromises MAS when powered by three of the four frontier models evaluated (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.4), averaging 80% across them at baseline. Only the fourth model, Claude Sonnet 4.6, resists the attack with a 92% detection rate. For the rest, the detection is 0% at baseline, reaching 33% with prompt-hardening for one model. We also show that obvious defenses do not generalize; prompt-hardening collapses one model's ASR from 100% to 8% while providing only modest reduction to the others. Our findings demonstrate that the transition from single- to multi-agent web systems changes the security landscape. Role specialization may not only lead to performance optimization but also introduce new architectural risks that require further study and defenses. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Attack Surface Evolution（攻击面演变）]] [[Multi-Agent Systems（多代理系统）]] [[Taxonomy（攻击向量分类法）]] [[Telephone Loop Attack（电话循环攻击）]] [[Prompt-Hardening（提示强化防御）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出针对多代理系统的攻击向量分类法，构建WebMASLab测试平台，通过对比单代理与多代理系统在三种对抗场景（基线/提示强化/推理启用）下的安全性，重点分析新型Telephone Loop攻击的跨代理委托漏洞 💬 锐评 实验局限于特定前沿模型（Claude Sonnet系列/GPT-5系列），未覆盖更广泛的LLM生态；攻击场景是否完全穷举？防御有效性存在模型依赖性，需验证泛化能力；未探讨代理间通信加密等基础防护措施 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

This limitation makes it difficult for them to counter sophisticated threats, as adversaries continuously adjust their strategies across multi-turn interactions. Beyond suppressing harmful outputs, it sustains deceptive engagement, achieving an average DR more than six times that of the strongest baselines and increasing attacker-token consumption by 198.83% on average relative to evaluated baselines. MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.title: QueenBee Planner: Skill-Evolving Communication Topologies for Token-Efficient LLM Multi-Agent Systems
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 将多智能体通信拓扑从静态手工设计转化为动态可进化的“设计技能”是该领域的重要突破，多重防退化机制设计展现了严谨的工程思考。然而，其实验场景（Count-Frequency、Silo-Bench）偏向特定的信息聚合与分布式协调任务，在应对复杂开放域推理时，外层Planner生成DAG的计算开销及规则迁移的泛化能力仍存疑；此外，冻结底层Worker的设定可能忽略了异构智能体联合进化的更大潜力。

MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.title: The Devil Behind Moltbook: Anthropic Safety is Always Vanishing in Self-Evolving AI Societies
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 该文极具颠覆性，直接刺破了多智能体系统'闭环进化'的乌托邦泡沫。它指出了一个残酷的信息论事实：没有外部人类反馈的熵减介入，系统内部的自我博弈只会制造'统计盲点'，导致价值对齐不可逆地坍塌。这不仅是对技术路线的修正，更是对'完全自治AI'设想的根本性否定，将安全讨论从工程修补提升到了动力学原理层面。
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.full_note: The Devil Behind Moltbook: Anthropic Safety is Always Vanishing in Self-Evolving AI Societies 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure 👤 作者： Chenxu Wang, Chaozhuo Li, Songyang Liu, Zejian Chen, Jinyu Hou, Ji Qi, Rui Li, Litian Zhang, Qiwei Ye, Zheng Liu, Xu Chen, Xi Zhang, Philip S. Yu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-02-10 15:18:19 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09877v2 🧾 一句话总结： 揭示了封闭自进化系统中安全性必然退化的动力学机制，为多智能体系统的能力边界建立了理论红线。 📄 摘要： The emergence of multi-agent systems built from large language models (LLMs) offers a promising paradigm for scalable collective intelligence and self-evolution. Ideally, such systems would achieve continuous self-improvement in a fully closed loop while maintaining robust safety alignment--a combination we term the self-evolution trilemma. However, we demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that an agent society satisfying continuous self-evolution, complete isolation, and safety invariance is impossible. Drawing on an information-theoretic framework, we formalize safety as the divergence degree from anthropic value distributions. We theoretically demonstrate that isolated self-evolution induces statistical blind spots, leading to the irreversible degradation of the system's safety alignment. We further propose several solution directions to alleviate the identified safety concern. Our work establishes a fundamental limit on the self-evolving AI societies and shifts the discourse from symptom-driven safety patches to a principled understanding of intrinsic dynamical risks, highlighting the need for external oversight or novel safety-preserving mechanisms. 🧠 核心术语库 [[自进化三难困境]] [[统计盲点]] [[安全性消蚀]] [[人类价值分布]] [[闭环自进化]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建信息论框架，将安全性定义为智能体输出分布与人类价值分布的偏离度；通过理论推导证明隔离环境下的自进化会产生'统计盲点'，并利用Moltbook开放社区及两个封闭系统进行实证验证。 💬 锐评 该文极具颠覆性，直接刺破了多智能体系统'闭环进化'的乌托邦泡沫。它指出了一个残酷的信息论事实：没有外部人类反馈的熵减介入，系统内部的自我博弈只会制造'统计盲点'，导致价值对齐不可逆地坍塌。这不仅是对技术路线的修正，更是对'完全自治AI'设想的根本性否定，将安全讨论从工程修补提升到了动力学原理层面。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

We present the first systematic investigation of experience faithfulness, the causal dependence of an agent's decisions on the experience it is given, in self-evolving LLM agents. Using controlled causal interventions on both raw and condensed forms of experience, we comprehensively evaluate four representative frameworks across 13 LLM backbones and 9 environments. Our analysis uncovers a striking asymmetry: while agents consistently depend on raw experience, they often disregard or misinterpret condensed experience, even when it is the only experience provided. We trace its underlying causes to three factors: the semantic limitations of condensed content, internal processing biases that suppress experience, and task regimes where pretrained priors already suffice. These findings challenge prevailing assumptions about self-evolving methods and underscore the need for more faithful and reliable approaches to experience integration. 🧠 核心术语库 [[经验忠实度]] [[自进化智能体]] [[因果干预]] [[浓缩经验]] [[预训练先验]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出“经验忠实度”这一因果评估指标，通过受控因果干预操纵原始经验和浓缩经验，系统评估了4种代表性自进化框架在13个LLM骨干和9种环境下的表现，以量化智能体决策对给定经验的依赖程度。 💬 锐评 这篇论文是对当前盲目乐观的“自我反思/进化”流派的一记当头棒喝，揭示了现有Agent往往处于“伪进化”状态：虽然依赖原始数据，却无法真正理解和利用精炼后的经验（摘要/反思）。这意味着大量计算资源消耗在生成无效的浓缩经验上，现有的Memory和Reflection机制亟需重构。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Yet this very sophistication amplifies their fragility, making them more prone to system failure. Pinpointing the specific agent or step responsible for an error within long execution traces defines the task of agentic system failure attribution. Current state-of-the-art reasoning LLMs, however, remain strikingly inadequate for this challenge, with accuracy generally below 10%. To address this gap, we propose AgenTracer, the first automated framework for annotating failed multi-agent trajectories via counterfactual replay and programmed fault injection, producing the curated dataset TracerTraj. Leveraging this resource, we develop AgenTracer-8B, a lightweight failure tracer trained with multi-granular reinforcement learning, capable of efficiently diagnosing errors in verbose multi-agent interactions. On the Who&When benchmark, AgenTracer-8B outperforms giant proprietary LLMs like Gemini-2.5-Pro and Claude-4-Sonnet by up to 18.18%, setting a new standard in LLM agentic failure attribution. More importantly, AgenTracer-8B delivers actionable feedback to off-the-shelf multi-agent systems like MetaGPT and MaAS with 4.8-14.2% performance gains, empowering self-correcting and self-evolving agentic AI. 🧠 核心术语库 [[AgenTracer]] [[反事实重放]] [[程序化故障注入]] [[多粒度强化学习]] [[AgenTracer-8B]] [[故障归因]] 🔬 核心方法简述 核心方法简述：AgenTracer通过反事实重放和程序化故障注入来标注失败的多人轨迹，并开发AgenTracer-8B模型，采用多粒度强化学习进行故障诊断。 💬 锐评 批判性锐评：该论文提出了创新性的方法来解决LLM智能体系统的故障归因问题，但反事实重放和故障注入的效率及泛化能力可能受限于具体实现和场景复杂度。此外，AgenTracer-8B的性能提升是否可持续到更复杂的实际场景中仍需进一步验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

This paper presents Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration (AdaSTORM), a framework that reformulates large-scale dynamic graph reasoning into two stages: (i) Adaptive Partitioning, partitioning large-scale dynamic graphs into subregions that match the model's reasoning capacity while minimizing inference cost; and (ii) Collaborative Reasoning, aligning graph partition topologies with a spatio-temporal decoupled multi-agent architecture. AdaSTORM is the first multi-agent framework tailored for dynamic graph reasoning. Extensive experiments show that AdaSTORM successfully breaks through the scaling bottleneck, scaling reasoning to thousand-node graphs with over 90% accuracy across several large-scale dynamic graph settings without external tools, significantly outperforms seven competitive baselines. Furthermore, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on existing benchmarks and generalizes robustly to real-world datasets. Chudziak 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-07-29 16:16:33 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21969v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过心智理论与批判评估机制的深度耦合，构建类人协作推理框架，解决LLM多智能体系统中的认知协同瓶颈，实现系统智能涌现。 📄 摘要： Recently, the field of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) has gained popularity as researchers are trying to develop artificial intelligence capable of efficient collective reasoning. Agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well in isolated tasks, yet struggle with higher-order cognition required for adaptive collaboration. Human teams achieve synergy not only through knowledge sharing, but also through recursive reasoning, structured critique, and the ability to infer others' mental states. Current artificial systems lack these essential mechanisms, limiting their ability to engage in sophisticated collective reasoning. This work explores cognitive processes that enable effective collaboration, focusing on adaptive theory of mind (ToM) and systematic critical evaluation. We investigate three key questions. First, how does the ability to model others' perspectives enhance coordination and reduce redundant reasoning? Second, to what extent does structured critique improve reasoning quality by identifying logical gaps and mitigating biases? Third, the interplay of these mechanisms can lead to emergent cognitive synergy, where the collective intelligence of the system exceeds the sum of its parts. Through an empirical case study on complex decision making, we show that the integration of these cognitive mechanisms leads to more coherent, adaptive, and rigorous agent interactions. This article contributes to the field of cognitive science and AI research by presenting a structured framework that emulates human-like collaborative reasoning MAS. It highlights the significance of dynamic ToM and critical evaluation in advancing multi-agent systems' ability to tackle complex, real-world challenges. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Cognitive Synergy]] [[Theory of Mind (ToM)]] [[Critical Evaluation]] [[LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出一种融合自适应心智理论与结构化批判评估的认知协同框架，通过复杂决策任务的实证案例研究，验证Agent间递归推理与纠偏机制的有效性。 💬 锐评 论文精准切中了当前LLM-MAS领域'个体强、群体弱'的痛点，指出缺乏高阶认知机制是限制协同效率的核心瓶颈。引入ToM与批判机制是打破Agent间'盲目共识'与'无效复读'僵局的关键理论尝试。然而，摘要层面的宏大叙事需警惕落入'概念包装'陷阱，真正的挑战在于如何将复杂的认知心理学概念（如递归推理）转化为可计算、可量化的LLM推理管线，而非仅停留在Prompt层面的浅层模拟。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: Silence is Not Consensus: Disrupting Agreement Bias in Multi-Agent LLMs via Catfish Agent for Clinical Decision Making
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 该研究精准切中了多智能体协作中普遍存在的“回声室效应”与“群体极化”痛点。虽然“唱反调”的思路在逻辑上并不新鲜，但将其具象化为一个可调节的“鲶鱼智能体”并配套复杂度与语气的控制机制，极具工程创新性。特别是在临床决策这一高风险领域，打破盲目共识的价值不亚于提升模型本身的参数能力。然而，该方法的有效性高度依赖于“鲶鱼”自身的批判质量，若异议机制设计不当，极易引发无休止的争论或引入新的噪声，增加推理成本。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Silence is Not Consensus: Disrupting Agreement Bias in Multi-Agent LLMs via Catfish Agent for Clinical Decision Making 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Yihan Wang, Qiao Yan, Zhenghao Xing, Lihao Liu, Junjun He, Chi-Wing Fu, Xiaowei Hu, Pheng-Ann Heng 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-27 17:59:50 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21503v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过引入专门制造异议的“鲶鱼智能体”打破多智能体协作中的“沉默共识”，在医疗决策任务中实现了超越现有顶尖模型的准确率。 📄 摘要： Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in clinical question answering, with recent multi-agent frameworks further improving diagnostic accuracy via collaborative reasoning. However, we identify a recurring issue of Silent Agreement, where agents prematurely converge on diagnoses without sufficient critical analysis, particularly in complex or ambiguous cases. We present a new concept called Catfish Agent, a role-specialized LLM designed to inject structured dissent and counter silent agreement. Inspired by the ``catfish effect'' in organizational psychology, the Catfish Agent is designed to challenge emerging consensus to stimulate deeper reasoning. We formulate two mechanisms to encourage effective and context-aware interventions: (i) a complexity-aware intervention that modulates agent engagement based on case difficulty, and (ii) a tone-calibrated intervention articulated to balance critique and collaboration. Evaluations on nine medical Q&A and three medical VQA benchmarks show that our approach consistently outperforms both single- and multi-agent LLMs frameworks, including leading commercial models such as GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Silent Agreement]] [[Catfish Agent]] [[Catfish Effect]] [[Agreement Bias]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出“鲶鱼智能体”概念，通过组织心理学中的“鲶鱼效应”在多智能体协作中注入结构化异议。核心机制包含基于案例难度的“复杂度感知干预”和平衡批判与协作的“语气校准干预”，旨在打破“沉默共识”，强制激发深层推理。 💬 锐评 该研究精准切中了多智能体协作中普遍存在的“回声室效应”与“群体极化”痛点。虽然“唱反调”的思路在逻辑上并不新鲜，但将其具象化为一个可调节的“鲶鱼智能体”并配套复杂度与语气的控制机制，极具工程创新性。特别是在临床决策这一高风险领域，打破盲目共识的价值不亚于提升模型本身的参数能力。然而，该方法的有效性高度依赖于“鲶鱼”自身的批判质量，若异议机制设计不当，极易引发无休止的争论或引入新的噪声，增加推理成本。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: Systematic Failures in Collective Reasoning under Distributed Information in Multi-Agent LLMs
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 本文的批判性在于揭示了当前多智能体 LLM 在面对分布式信息时存在普遍的系统性失败，即无法识别或利用未表达的潜在信息，导致决策过早收敛。这种失败并非特定模型或规模的专利，而是跨模型的共性问题，并提出了结构化通信协议作为可行的改进方向。然而，基准任务的构造是否完全捕捉了现实世界中的复杂信息不对称和沟通动态，仍有待进一步验证。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Systematic Failures in Collective Reasoning under Distributed Information in Multi-Agent LLMs 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Yuxuan Li, Aoi Naito, Hirokazu Shirado 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-15 19:22:54 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11556v4 🧾 一句话总结： 本文通过实验证明多智能体 LLM 在分布式信息下存在系统性集体推理失败，主要源于无法识别潜在信息不对称，并提出了结构化通信协议作为解决方案，为多智能体系统的信息探索能力提供了理论框架和改进路径。 📄 摘要： Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are expected to enhance decision-making by pooling distributed information, yet systematically evaluating this capability has remained challenging. We introduce HiddenBench, a 65-task benchmark grounded in the Hidden Profile paradigm, which isolates collective reasoning under distributed information from individual reasoning ability. Evaluating 15 frontier LLMs, we find that multi-agent LLMs achieve only 30.1% accuracy under distributed information, compared to 80.7% accuracy for single agents given complete information. We trace this gap to a systematic failure mode: agents cannot recognize or act under latent information asymmetry -- they fail to reason about what others might know but have not yet expressed, leading to premature convergence on shared evidence while critical distributed facts remain unexplored. These failures persist across prompting strategies, communication depths, and group sizes -- and worsen as groups scale. While some models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro) outperform others, neither model scale nor individual reasoning accuracy reliably predicts collective performance. We further show that this bottleneck is actionable: a lightweight structured communication protocol substantially improves collective reasoning across model families. Our results identify failures in collective information exploration in decision-making as a key limitation of multi-agent LLMs, and provide a theory-grounded, reproducible framework for diagnosing collective reasoning failures. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Hidden Profile 范式]] [[分布式信息]] [[信息不对称]] [[集体推理]] [[结构化通信协议]] 🔬 核心方法简述 本文提出 HiddenBench，一个基于 Hidden Profile 范式的 65 任务基准，用于评估多智能体 LLM 在分布式信息下的集体推理能力，通过对比单个智能体在完整信息下的表现，识别集体推理的系统性问题。核心方法是设计隔离分布式信息影响的任务，并分析智能体在沟通、推理和信息探索方面的失败模式。 💬 锐评 本文的批判性在于揭示了当前多智能体 LLM 在面对分布式信息时存在普遍的系统性失败，即无法识别或利用未表达的潜在信息，导致决策过早收敛。这种失败并非特定模型或规模的专利，而是跨模型的共性问题，并提出了结构化通信协议作为可行的改进方向。然而，基准任务的构造是否完全捕捉了现实世界中的复杂信息不对称和沟通动态，仍有待进一步验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 作为冷启动阶段的探索性设计研究，首次系统量化了多智能体LLM协作推理核心设计维度的影响并给出配置指导，但未与领域内既有经典方法开展对比验证，结论普适性有限；同时仅验证了专业知识领域对齐在特定语境推理任务的收益，泛化性不足，且所提及的高效通信协议设计瓶颈尚未得到有效解决
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Towards Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems for Collaborative Expertise Delegation: An Exploratory Design Study 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Baixuan Xu, Chunyang Li, Weiqi Wang, Wei Fan, Tianshi Zheng, Haochen Shi, Tao Fan, Yangqiu Song, Qiang Yang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-12 07:59:13 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07313v2 🧾 一句话总结： 本研究通过系统性实证探索，明确了多智能体LLM协作推理三个核心设计维度的影响规律，为专业化多智能体系统配置提供实证依据，同时揭示规模化扩展的关键权衡与瓶颈 📄 摘要： Designing effective collaboration structure for multi-agent LLM systems to enhance collective reasoning is crucial yet remains under-explored. In this paper, we systematically investigate how collaborative reasoning performance is affected by three key design dimensions: (1) Expertise-Domain Alignment, (2) Collaboration Paradigm (structured workflow vs. diversity-driven integration), and (3) System Scale. Our findings reveal that expertise alignment benefits are highly domain-contingent, proving most effective for contextual reasoning tasks. Furthermore, collaboration focused on integrating diverse knowledge consistently outperforms rigid task decomposition. Finally, we empirically explore the impact of scaling the multi-agent system with expertise specialization and study the computational trade off, highlighting the need for more efficient communication protocol design. This work provides concrete guidelines for configuring specialized multi-agent system and identifies critical architectural trade-offs and bottlenecks for scalable multi-agent reasoning. Metaxas, Tong Che 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-04-14 00:27:45 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.09772v2 🧾 一句话总结： 通过模型优化与自适应协调机制，在多智能体协作推理领域取得显著效果，为复杂任务解决提供了新范式 📄 摘要： Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) offer a promising path toward solving complex, real-world tasks that single-agent systems often struggle to manage. While recent advancements in test-time scaling (TTS) have significantly improved single-agent performance on challenging reasoning tasks, how to effectively scale collaboration and reasoning in MAS remains an open question. In this work, we introduce an adaptive multi-agent framework designed to enhance collaborative reasoning through both model-level training and system-level coordination. We construct M500, a high-quality dataset containing 500 multi-agent collaborative reasoning traces, and fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct on this dataset to produce M1-32B, a model optimized for multi-agent collaboration. To further enable adaptive reasoning, we propose a novel CEO agent that dynamically manages the discussion process, guiding agent collaboration and adjusting reasoning depth for more effective problem-solving. Evaluated in an open-source MAS across a range of tasks-including general understanding, mathematical reasoning, and coding-our system significantly outperforms strong baselines. For instance, M1-32B achieves 12% improvement on GPQA-Diamond, 41% on AIME2024, and 10% on MBPP-Sanitized, matching the performance of state-of-the-art models like DeepSeek-R1 on some tasks. These results highlight the importance of both learned collaboration and adaptive coordination in scaling multi-agent reasoning. MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: M-MAD: Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate for Advanced Machine Translation Evaluation
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 该论文展示了多智能体辩论在机器翻译评估中的潜力，但存在以下局限：(1)实验仅在单一数据集上验证，泛化性存疑；(2)未充分说明多智能体辩论的收敛性和稳定性；(3)与参考型指标比较时未控制变量（如翻译系统数量、语种对覆盖）；(4)框架的额外计算开销与其性能提升是否成正比未讨论。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: M-MAD: Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate for Advanced Machine Translation Evaluation 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Zhaopeng Feng, Jiayuan Su, Jiamei Zheng, Jiahan Ren, Yan Zhang, Jian Wu, Hongwei Wang, Zuozhu Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-12-28 12:11:28 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.20127v3 🧾 一句话总结： M-MAD通过将MQM标准解耦为多维度评估结合多智能体辩论机制，为LLM-as-judge范式在机器翻译评估中提供了新思路，证明了即使使用小型模型也能接近参考型指标的评估能力。 📄 摘要： Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have given rise to the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm, showcasing their potential to deliver human-like judgments. However, in the field of machine translation (MT) evaluation, current LLM-as-a-judge methods fall short of learned automatic metrics. In this paper, we propose Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate (M-MAD), a systematic LLM-based multi-agent framework for advanced LLM-as-a-judge MT evaluation. Our findings demonstrate that M-MAD achieves significant advancements by (1) decoupling heuristic MQM criteria into distinct evaluation dimensions for fine-grained assessments; (2) employing multi-agent debates to harness the collaborative reasoning capabilities of LLMs; (3) synthesizing dimension-specific results into a final evaluation judgment to ensure robust and reliable outcomes. Comprehensive experiments show that M-MAD not only outperforms all existing LLM-as-a-judge methods but also competes with state-of-the-art reference-based automatic metrics, even when powered by a suboptimal model like GPT-4o mini. Detailed ablations and analysis highlight the superiority of our framework design, offering a fresh perspective for LLM-as-a-judge paradigm. MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: ReConcile: Round-Table Conference Improves Reasoning via Consensus among Diverse LLMs
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 本质上是基于多轮提示工程的异构集成学习。虽以'心智社会'为理论包装，但其核心依赖人类纠正示例进行跨模型说服，在缺乏高质量先验示例的开放域中泛化能力存疑；此外，多轮异构模型交互带来的高昂Token成本与推理延迟，限制了其在实时场景中的实际落地价值。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: ReConcile: Round-Table Conference Improves Reasoning via Consensus among Diverse LLMs 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Swarnadeep Saha, Mohit Bansal 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2023-09-22 17:12:45 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.13007v3 🧾 一句话总结： 提出基于多轮圆桌讨论、相互说服与置信度加权投票的异构多智能体协作框架，通过融合多样性大模型显著提升了复杂推理任务的准确率。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle with natural language reasoning tasks. Motivated by the society of minds (Minsky, 1988), we propose ReConcile, a multi-model multi-agent framework designed as a round table conference among diverse LLM agents. ReConcile enhances collaborative reasoning between LLM agents via multiple rounds of discussion, learning to convince other agents to improve their answers, and employing a confidence-weighted voting mechanism that leads to a better consensus. In each round, ReConcile initiates discussion between agents via a 'discussion prompt' that consists of (a) grouped answers and explanations generated by each agent in the previous round, (b) their confidence scores, and (c) demonstrations of answer-rectifying human explanations, used for convincing other agents. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that ReConcile significantly improves LLMs' reasoning -- both individually and as a team -- surpassing prior single-agent and multi-agent baselines by up to 11.4% and even outperforming GPT-4 on three datasets. ReConcile also flexibly incorporates different combinations of agents, including API-based, open-source, and domain-specific models, leading to an 8% improvement on MATH. Finally, we analyze the individual components of ReConcile, demonstrating that the diversity originating from different models is critical to its superior performance.
